content.text:
All 18 rules were searched across the full document and one plan per rule has been submitted.

Key planning observations for the reviewing team:

- **This is a consortium construction & maintenance agreement (APCN 2), not a vendor/customer supply contract.** Many playbook rules map onto reciprocal, multi-party mechanics rather than one-sided vendor obligations. Workers should weigh mutuality before proposing redlines — several provisions (audit/review rights at Para 9, non-discriminatory access at Para 17, MFN-style "no less favorable" terms at p0220) run in our favour and should not be flagged.
- **Strongest deviation candidates:** WARRANTY (only a disclaimer at p0126–p0127, no performance warranty or remedy to us), INSURANCE (permissive only, p0139), LOL-CAP (no monetary cap and no carve-outs, p0240/p0242), GOVLAW (no governing law or venue designated; committee-determined process is the sole and exclusive remedy, p0262), and TRANSITION (asset realization only, no data return or migration help).
- **Likely absent:** NONCOMPETE, EXCLUSIVITY and NOSOLICIT returned no responsive restraint across multiple seed sets; p0206/p0208 affirmatively confirm freedom to resell without restriction.
- **Cross-rule overlap to avoid double-flagging:** the capital-cost forfeiture at p0233 is responsive to T4C, LD and MINCOMMIT. It should be analysed once (most naturally under T4C or MINCOMMIT) unless two rules are independently breached.
- **Term structure:** 25-year Initial Period with continuation by agreement (p0228) rather than auto-renewal — a note, not an auto-renewal deviation.
